claim: The frozen offline evaluator has no verified candidate-generated-text to text-responsive-receiver path; observational/feasibility-only is recommended pending an explicit user decision.

boundary_findings.bargaining: Candidate text may be present at structured.message, but BargainingPolicy and terminal payoff ignore it.
boundary_findings.negotiation: Candidate text may be present at structured.message, but NegotiationPolicy and terminal payoff ignore it.
boundary_findings.persuasion_candidate_seller: Buyer policy consumes buy_no_buy or structured.decision and ignores candidate words.
boundary_findings.persuasion_candidate_buyer: Candidate can optionally consume opponent-seller free text, but this reverses the intervention direction and is not an eligible candidate-language cell.
